stemMd: Which compound contains a carbon-carbon double bond?
explanationMd: Ethene is the simplest alkene and contains a carbon-carbon double bond. Ethane is an alkane with a single bond, while ethyne is an alkyne with a triple bond. The suffixes provide a useful check on the structural classification.

distractorRationale.e: Ethane contains a carbon-carbon single bond.
distractorRationale.b: Methane has only one carbon atom.
distractorRationale.c: Ethyne contains a carbon-carbon triple bond.
distractorRationale.d: Methanol has only one carbon and no carbon-carbon bond.
